candidate_merges.message: Fix TypeScript Bicep parameter expressions on enum Azure properties (#20557) ## Description TypeScript AppHosts currently fail when `configureInfrastructure` assigns a `bicep().parameter(...)` expression to an enum-valued Azure provisioning property, such as a Storage SKU name. The generated TypeScript accepts the assignment, but publishing stops with `A value of type String cannot be assigned to a BicepValue<StorageSkuName>`. Allow string-backed Bicep expressions to flow into enum-valued proper
